title: Drum set on the advertising trucks
summary: The drum set he used on the trucks had an overhead foot pedal, one cymbal and a woodblock, and he sat at the front of the truck.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used

blocks.x: Well, uh, when you played on the trucks like everybody petite, uh, what kind of a drum set did you have at that time, alright?
